Priti is extremely dedicated, attentive and pays individual attention to each student.  Her routine challenges your body and helps you understand your body better.
I noticed a significant difference in my balance and posture after doing yoga with her for only a couple of months. Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Juee Bhalekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been practicing yoga with Priti Mam for a while and I can definitely observe noticeable differences in my body – I gained so much flexibility and strength! It’s challenging, but through the clear instructions and consistency of the trainings I can feel great results. Also Priti Mam is very sweet and brings a very positive energy to the class. I love it! Recommend Dhyandeep Yoga classes to everyone!
